certification.name: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architecture SC-100 Professional Certificate
certification.description: Five-course advanced program on security architecture: Zero Trust identity models, network segmentation, DevSecOps pipelines and cyber risk reporting, aligned to the SC-100 exam. Course-based certificate assessed through five portfolio projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week.
